quotes.text: "calendar for new event should be the first writeable calendar in the list"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For a new item with an unusable selected calendar, the dialog first checks whether usable candidates remain. It orders them with sortCalendarArray before selecting index 0 and updating calendarItem.calendar. That helper follows calendar.list.sortOrder and can repair the preference when given all calendars. The added test directly checks both the usable selected-calendar case and the reordered fallback case; it was not executed here.
title: New-item calendar fallback sorts usable candidates before selecting the first
